narration.full_text: Let's begin our exploration by understanding what exactly a solar system is. Simply put, a solar system is a collection of celestial bodies. At its heart is a star, like our Sun, and orbiting around this star are various objects. These objects include planets, dwarf planets, moons, asteroids, comets, and even dust and gas. All these components are bound together by the star's immense gravitational pull. Our own solar system, for instance, revolves around the Sun, which is its central star. The Sun's gravity is what keeps Earth and all the other planets in their respective orbits, preventing them from drifting off into space. It's a beautifully balanced cosmic dance!
